name: Hiroba Food Hall
description: Hiroba Food Hall — a block theme for a city food hall with several kitchens under one roof, built around the weekday lunch. The home page opens on a rounded window on a pale ground that holds a sideways strip of film-grain photographs, then a today's-hours strip with a vertical hairline and a convex arc edge, kitchen cards whose round medallion straddles the cover photo, caps title lockups with a short gold rule and gold words, a horizontal lunch-hour ruler with a gold peak bar, a parallax hall photograph, held tables on a stone band, guest notes and a visit band. Fraunces for headings, Literata for reading. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; gentle scroll effects that stop under reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: headings, caps title lockups, figures, wordmark (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, buttons, hours (variable 200-900, Latin subset)
